---
name: Reproducible defect
about: Report a source, integration or compatibility problem
---

## Exact affected identity

Repository revision or public candidate identifier, dependency versions, and relevant environment.

## Reproduction

Smallest safe steps, expected behavior, observed result and frequency. Record the verification lane. Share redacted metadata only.

## Boundaries and acceptance

Owning component, affected prerequisites, regression control and a check that would close the issue.
